tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---INITIAL---"; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "---NEW---"; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---COUNTS---"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command:
hops fg create customersf279b7 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --features "row_id:string,name:string,balance_eur:double,updated_at:bigint" \
  --description "Customers initial schema" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert customersf279b7 --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25

hops fg create customersf279b7 --version 2 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --features "row_id:string,full_name:string,balance:double,currency:string,updated_at:bigint" \
  --online \
  --description "Customers new schema (online enabled)" \
  --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Create feature group version 2 with online store

tool_input.command: hops fg insert customersf279b7 --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -15
hops fg info customersf279b7 --version 2 --json 2>&1 | grep -Ei '"name"|online|version|"id"' | head -20; echo "===PREVIEW==="; hops fg preview customersf279b7 --version 2 --json 2>&1 | tail -30
hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customersf279b7_2" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops --no-verify sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customersf279b7_2" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
